Case: Wai is a 29-year-old metastatic medulloblastoma status-post multiple rounds of chemotherapy and radiation therapy, presenting with several months of progressive leg pain. Question: Would you offer morphine to Wai? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
